blocks.text: Canada-based Daren Dyhengco’s musical journey began with a promise some years ago, only to be put on hold when the coronavirus pandemic brought the world to a standstill. But now that everything has gone back to normal, the Filipino-Chinese artist has found his rhythm again, returning to a passion that he never stopped loving. Daren sat down with INQUIRER Entertainment and two other writers recently, and what everyone saw was a man who has not lost his excitement for the next chapter of his career.
